sloka: दिष्ट्या त्वया हतो राजन्रावणो लोकरावणः ।न हि भारः स ते राम रावणः पुत्रपौत्रवान् ।। ७.१.१८ ॥
transliteration: diṣṭyā tvayā hato rājanrāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ ।na hi bhāraḥ sa te rāma rāvaṇaḥ putrapautravān ।। 7.1.18 ॥

translations.english: O King, it is fortunate that you have slain Ravana, who tormented the worlds, for indeed, even with his sons and grandsons, he was no match for you, O Rama.
